app_fee.value: The non-refundable international graduate application fee is $65 USD ($55 USD for domestic applicants).
app_fee.quote: Submit the non-refundable application fee of $65.00.

fee_waiver.value: ETSU's Graduate School states that it does not provide application fee waivers (the only listed exception on the application instructions page is for currently enrolled ETSU graduate students).
fee_waiver.quote: Please note that the Graduate School does not provide application fee waivers. The application fee is a required processing fee. The only exception to this is if you are a currently enrolled graduate student at ETSU.

gre_general.value: Set by each individual graduate program (for example, Biomedical Sciences Ph.D. does not require the GRE).

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score for graduate admission is 4.0 on the post-January 21, 2026 scale (or 79 on the pre-January 21, 2026 scale).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT (after January 21, 2026) 4.0 TOEFL iBT (before January 21, 2026) 79

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic overall score for graduate admission is 6.5 (PTE Academic 53 is also accepted).

english_waiver.value: India is not on ETSU's exempt-country list for English proficiency; Indian applicants must submit TOEFL (4.0 new / 79 legacy), IELTS (6.5), or PTE (53) unless they hold a U.S. institution degree or meet rare U.S. employment/study or USMLE exceptions.
english_waiver.quote: All international applicants must provide proof of English proficiency by submitting documentation of one of the following: ... Applicants who have earned a degree from an accredited U.S. institution are exempt. | The Graduate School may waive the language proficiency test requirement in rare circumstances

notes: International applicants must submit a course-by-course NACES transcript evaluation (ECE, IEE, TEC, or WES; allow 8+ weeks). Indian three-year bachelor's degrees from NAAC 'A' (3.01-4.0) accredited universities are accepted as equivalent to four-year U.S. bachelor's degrees; individual year marksheets are required (summary marksheets are not accepted). International GAs/scholarship recipients must complete an Oral Proficiency Exam on campus.
